cost.binNote: Bin lists this constant as BriarP.CurrentHealthPercentCost=0.05 (filed under the passive slot in the sheet) rather than under BriarE; no separate E-slot row exists for it.

castTime.binNote: Wiki gives two distinct cast times: None for the initial cast (charging starts immediately) and 0.15 for the recast; the bin has no cast-time field at all for this slot, so this recast time cannot be validated against the bin. The initial-cast component is null/none.

values.binNote: Per-tick value is the wiki's own division of HealHPPercent by 4 (ticks every 0.25s over up to 1s); the sheet has no separate per-tick data row.
The 2.5% minimum is a wiki-side scaling of BriarE#Damage/BriarE.MaxBaseDamage with no dedicated bin row of its own.

values.meaning: Bonus Magic Damage on wall collision

mechanics.claim: Chilling Scream's damage and range grow the longer it is charged, up to 1 second, at which point it deals maximum damage and range.
mechanics.quote: charging for up to 1 second, during which she increases ''Chilling Scream's'' damage and range

mechanics.claim: During the charge, damage increases from its minimum every 0.025 seconds.
mechanics.quote: ''Chilling Scream'' increases its damage by its minimum every {{fd|0.025}} seconds over the duration.

mechanics.claim: The charge cannot be interrupted by crowd control, so the full-duration charge (and its damage reduction/heal) is always reachable barring death.
mechanics.quote: ''Chilling Scream's'' charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.

mechanics.claim: While charging, Briar gains 35% damage reduction, lowering damage taken.
mechanics.quote: gains 35% damage reduction and {{tip|heal|heals}} herself every {{fd|0.25}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Briar heals herself every 0.25 seconds while charging.
The ability recasts (releases the scream) automatically at the end of the charge if not recast manually beforehand.
mechanics.quote: ''Chilling Scream'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

mechanics.claim: Only a full-duration (1 second) charge produces the knockback and wall-collision bonus damage; a shorter charge only deals the scaled damage and slow.
mechanics.quote: If ''Chilling Scream'' was charged for its full duration, enemies hit are also {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} 575 units.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins only after the recast/effect resolves, not at the initial cast.
